            label="k energy  Cu_foil_1  Cu_foil_2",

##| Set first and second derivative of xmu data
g.der = deriv(g.xmu)/deriv(g.energy)
g.sec = deriv(g.der)/deriv(g.energy)
##| Set first and second derivative of normalized data
g.nder = deriv(g.norm)/deriv(g.energy)
g.nsec = deriv(g.nder)/deriv(g.energy)

##| Set first derivative of phase in R
g.dph = deriv(g.chir_pha)/deriv(g.r)
g.dph = (max(g.chir_mag) / max(abs(g.dph))) * g.dph

##| post autobk
g.nbkg = (g.bkg - g.pre_edge) / 3.2 + 0.35

##|
##| make the flattened, normalized spectrum
##|   flat_cN are the difference in slope and curvature between
##|   the pre- and post-edge polynomials
##|
##|  compute a step function
##|
n___step     = 3
n___points    = size(g.energy) - n___step
t___oss       = group(__name__='t___oss')
t___oss.zeros = zeros(n___step)
t___oss.ones  = ones(n___points)
g.theta = array(list(t___oss.zeros) + list(t___oss.ones))
##|
flat_c0 = 0.2 - 0.1
flat_c1 = 0.003 - 0.001
if 2 >= 2:
   flat_c2 = 0
else:
   flat_c2 = 0
#endif
if 2 == 3:
   flat_c3 = 0
else:
   flat_c3 = 0
#endif
g.line = (flat_c0 + flat_c1*(g.energy+2.25) + flat_c2*(g.energy+2.25)**2)
g.flat = ((3.2 - g.line)*g.theta + g.prex) / 3.2
g.fbkg = (g.bkg-g.pre_edge+(3.2-g.line)*g.theta)/3.2

##| clean up after computing flattened spectrum
del t___oss, flat_c0, flat_c1, flat_c2, flat_c3
g.int = interp(g.energy+2.25, g.xmu, h.energy+2.25, fill_value=0.0)
